cards.title: Toddlers deserve respect for their unique culture
cards.body: Small children have their own distinct culture that adults should honor rather than dismiss. Respecting toddlers means valuing their interests, like their singing and collections, without judgment or interference.

cards.title: What children notice about parental honesty
cards.body: Children closely observe whether parents' words match their actions, noticing inconsistencies more than adults realize. Kids learn about honesty by watching what you actually do, not just what you say.

cards.title: Five lessons babies teach about well-being
cards.body: Babies offer unexpected wisdom about happiness through their natural approach to living. Learning from infants can help adults reconnect with fundamental principles of well-being.

cards.title: How to handle body comments at family events
cards.body: Holiday gatherings often bring harmful comments about girls' bodies from relatives. Parents can protect children's body image by setting boundaries and redirecting inappropriate discussions.

cards.title: AI reveals important truths about children's learning
cards.body: A struggling reader successfully built a detailed Titanic model, showing executive function and exploration skills beyond traditional measures. This reveals how different forms of learning reveal hidden abilities in children.

cards.title: Girls inherit body shame from women they love
cards.body: Daughters learn what to think about their bodies by observing the women closest to them. Breaking cycles of body criticism starts with parents modeling self-acceptance.

cards.title: Don't buy Grand Theft Auto VI for kids
cards.body: Rockstar's latest game is rated 18 and contains extreme sex, drugs, and violence unsuitable for children. Parents should understand the content before any purchase consideration.

cards.title: Missed safeguarding chances in toddler's death
cards.body: A review found safeguarding failures that could have prevented a two-year-old's murder by grandparents despite father's concerns. The board apologized unreservedly for the missed opportunities to protect the child.
